_about: Hand-authored resolutions for concert cards the automatic mapper could not classify safely.
Keyed by `sourceIndex` from concerts.raw.json. Applied by normalise-content.mjs.
Each entry records WHAT was decided and WHY, so the call is auditable rather than buried
in a heuristic. `null` means 'the original genuinely does not state this'.
Nothing here invents information: every value is present in the source card, only assigned
to a different field than the mapper could infer.

0.why: A five-city tour, not a single venue. 'CHINA TOUR' is the tour name (series); the bullet list is the cities. No venue is stated for any stop.

13.why: Three concerts over three days (29, 30 Nov, 1 Dec) in three cities. Kept as ONE entry because the source does not state which date belongs to which city — splitting would require inventing that mapping. Salamanka has no venue given. Flagged to the client as a possible split.
13.clientQuestion: Should the 29 Nov – 1 Dec Spain run be split into three separate concerts? If so, which city on which date?

14.why: Two concerts on 25 and 26 Nov in two cities. Kept as one entry for the same reason as #13 — the date-to-city mapping is not stated. NOT part of the Paganini Ensemble EU Tour: this card is the Győr Philharmonic Orchestra's 'TOUR 2025' (Strauss & Kreisler Jubilee Gala), so `series` is left to the classifier rather than copied from #13. Verified against the concerts-modal screenshot.
14.clientQuestion: Split the 25–26 Nov Spain run into two concerts? Which city on which date?

15.why: Two concerts on 20 and 21 Nov in two Hungarian cities. Kept as one entry, same reasoning as #13. Same Győr Philharmonic 'TOUR 2025' as #14 — the Hungarian leg. The two cards sharing an orchestra and programme is correct, not a duplication error.
15.clientQuestion: Split the 20–21 Nov Hungary run into two concerts? Which city on which date? Also: the Info link on this card points at sion-violon-musique.ch, a Swiss festival — is that the right link for a Hungarian concert?

set.series: I International Sofia Cantus Firmus Competition for Violinists

20.why: Not a performance — Mario Hossen sat on the jury. The single source line is a role description, not a venue. Kept on the concerts list because that is where the original shows it.
20.clientQuestion: Should jury appearances sit in the concerts list, or in a separate section?

26.why: 'I SOLISTI VENETI' is the orchestra, not a venue. No venue is stated on the card.

27.why: 'Liszt Festival' is the festival, not a venue. No venue is stated on the card.

28.why: The festival name, not a venue. No venue is stated. `series` is left as the classifier reads it — 'Varna Summer Music Festival Festival', duplicated word and all. The typo is the client's to fix, not ours to silently correct.
28.clientQuestion: 'Varna Summer Music Festival Festival' has a duplicated word — correct it?
